result:
I’d make it harder for people to outsource suffering to abstraction.

If I could change one thing, I’d make the consequences of actions more immediate and legible across distance and time, so people couldn’t easily separate their comfort from other people’s pain. Not because guilt is good, but because the world now lets responsibility disappear into “other people’s problem.”
